'''Starck''' was a [[human]]<ref name="Galaxy of Heroes" /> [[colonel]] in the [[Imperial Army|ground forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Military|military]]<ref name="CL 2016" /> who had [[Color|light]] skin.<ref name="Galaxy of Heroes" /> During the [[Battle of Hoth]], Starck commanded the [[All Terrain Armored Transport (Galactic Civil War)|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[walker]] [[Blizzard 4]] of [[Blizzard Force]], under the overall direction of [[General]] [[Maximilian Veers]]. Colonel Starck was killed when Blizzard 4 was destroyed by [[Luke Skywalker]] when the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] activated a [[concussion grenade]] inside the [[walker]].<ref name="CL 2016" /><ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
